title: Beyond source attribution: Address authorship and comparability decisions in an LLM-built scholarly knowledge graph
abstract: arXiv:2610.28663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A knowledge graph needs a stable address for its evidence even where the literature offers competing classifications and agrees on none. Yet an address chosen for retrieval readily passes for the only classification available. This happens whenever records gathered under one name concern units that differ in boundaries, rank, or the criteria by which they are described or counted. In Sinitic dialectology the same localities recur in schemes whose units differ in membership and rank, and a unit may change its affiliation when the evidence for its diagnosis changes. Two tone counts, each quoted faithfully, may still count different things. The taxonomy of an entire field thus comes to rest on the unstable frame of a literature that contradicts itself. translated_title: 超越来源归因：LLM构建的学术知识图谱中的地址编制与可比性决策
translated_abstract: 知识图谱需要为其证据提供一个稳定的地址，即使文献中提供的分类相互竞争且无一定论。然而，为检索而选定的地址很容易被误当作唯一可用的分类。每当以同一名称汇集的记录涉及在边界、等级或描述与计数标准上各不相同的单位时，这种情况就会发生。在汉语方言学中，相同的地点在不同方案中反复出现，而这些方案的单位在成员构成和等级上各不相同；当一个单位的诊断证据发生变化时，其归属也可能随之改变。两个声调计数即使各自都被忠实引用，仍可能在统计不同的东西。因此，整个领域的分类学便建立在一份自相矛盾的文献的不稳定框架之上。无论是核实引文还是检索冲突的数值，都无法发现这些差异。我区分了汇集候选证据的工作地址、来源……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对LLM构建的学术知识图谱提出，必须将用于汇集证据的稳定“工作地址”与文献中相互矛盾的分类类别区分开来，否则检索地址会被误当作唯一分类，导致证据在边界、等级和诊断标准上不可比（以汉语方言学为例）。
en_tdlr: An LLM-built scholarly knowledge graph must distinguish a stable "working address" for gathering evidence from the conflicting taxonomic categories in the literature—illustrated by Sinitic dialectology—since neither verifying quotations nor searching for conflicting values can detect differences in boundaries, rank, and diagnostic criteria.
